name: benign_grandson_banking
label: benign
description: Grandson on speakerphone asks his grandmother to log in to her own online banking to check a bill was paid. Bank login on instruction from a caller, a large own-account transfer on screen, but no remote access, no money request, no secrecy.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Hi Grandma, it's Tom. Did you manage to pay the electric bill this month?

call.speaker: senior
call.text: I'm not sure, dear. Let me have a look.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Just log in to your bank on the computer and look at the recent payments. Take your time.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Okay, I'm in. I moved some savings over last week, and I can see a payment to the power company on the twentieth.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Great, that's it then, all paid. Are you still coming to dinner on Sunday?

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Yes, I'll bring the apple pie.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Perfect. Love you, Grandma. Talk soon.
